Name: Amythistle
Description: A powerful slug that can shoot gems from its body, attacking with precision in all directions.

Name: Refracent
Description: A slug that reflect or adjust the trajectory of any projectile or attack.

Name: Makobreaker
Description: A shark themed slug that can shoot their teeth like bullets from its mouth.

Name: Tenasher
Description: An crocodile slug that has a colossal mouth, able to chomp through almost anything.

Name: Spikeshade
Description: A porcupine slug that can shoot poisonous quills that linger in the air for hours.

Name: Chlorobite
Description: A plant slug that can shoot razor sharp leaves from its body with deadly accuracy.

Name: Mantarid
Description: A manta ray type slug that can phase through solid objects, such as the ground and walls.

Name: Gyrophyll
Description: A spinning slug that can charge up and release its speed or wind from its body.

Name: Chasm
Description: A special slug capable of teleporting victims it grasps to random locations.

Name: Taranticle
Description: A tarantula slug able to extend and use its powerful 8 legs.

Name: Mandimesh
Description: An enormous slug capable of ensnaring foes in its flexible body mesh.

Name: Rammstone
Description: A hard hitting slug capable of ramming, smashing through various obstacles.

Name: Armashelt
Description: A heavy-duty slug with thick armor that can deal a lot of damage,

Name: Grenuke
Description: A slug capable of sticking to any surface and explode after a short delay.

Name: Hoprock
Description: A explosive slug that serves as primary explopsive ammunition for most Slugslingers.

Name: Crystalyd
Description: A tunneling slug that can dig through rock and earth, useful for various situations.

Name: Dirt Urchin
Description: A slug that can fling their spikes at an opponent or burrow towards them before striking.

Name: Sand Angler
Description: An armored burrowing slug that can surround their target with quicksand.

Name: Speedstinger
Description: An extremely fast slug that are mostly used for trick shots, complicated moves and quick attacks.

Name: Glowbyss
Description: A bioluminescent slug able to blind and stun an opponent with a flash of light.

Name: Tormato
Description: A slug that can create gale-force winds or rampaging tornadoes to blow away their target.

Name: Firenzar
Description: A dragon like slug able to unleash powerful spirals of fire from its flaps.

Name: Forgesmelter
Description: A slug that can melt or solder metal, and produce small molten metal explosions.

Name: Lavalynx
Description: A terrifying slug that holds the same power as a volcano, spewing and erupting lava.

Name: Flaringo
Description: The most basic fire type slug, able to shoot small fireballs and sparks towards a target.

Name: Arachnet
Description: A multipurpose spider slug able to use its webs for various functions.

Name: Slicksilver
Description: A slug that can transform into a giant living ball of magnetized metal, creating a powerful magnetic field.

Name: Aquabeek
Description: A common water slug able to shoot fast, high-pressure streams of water from its body.

Name: Hexlet
Description: A dangerous slug that can bring bad luck upon its target.

Name: Gazzer
Description: A gaseous slug that can release clouds of gas that can disorient opponents.

Name: Geoshard
Description: An extremely dangerous slug that can create a projectile that crystallizes the target on contact.

Name: Hoverbug
Description: A simple and fast flying slug that can also be used to carry objects and people.

Name: Diggrix
Description: A defensive slug used to quickly dig trenches or escape routes in the ground.

Name: Thresher
Description: A strong, multipurpose slug with an insanely sharp spine/tail that can cut through almost anything.

Name: Negashade
Description: A psychic slug known for its darkness, creating illusions and manipulating shadows.

Name: Midas
Description: A golden slug that can enhance certain attributes of other slugs or objects it comes into contact with.

Name: Frostcrawler
Description: A common ice slug that can freeze targets with its chilly breath.

Name: Slyren
Description: A hypnotic slug that can lull or blast targets with their screeching song.

Name: Flopper
Description: An underlooked slug asit lacks any ability, making it almost useless.

Name: Kinderling
Description: A murderous slug that can evaporate liquids in seconds upon contact.

Name: Mesagator
Description: A sly alligator like slug that can hide its body in any body of liquid.

Name: Fungaroo
Description: A kangaroo like slug, secondary to a Speedstinger, able to ricochet and bounce faster but is rarer.

Name: Dreamiese
Description: A deadly slug that can send targets into a long, deep sleep.
